notes.title: Steam FPS Fest 2024
notes.content:
Welcome to the Steam FPS Fest 2024 - the ultimate sale on FPS games! Prepare for a journey through the human organism in Project Remedium. As a nanobot, you will have to reverse the effects of a strange illness and a series of unfortunate events.

[previewyoutube=RgHhdwDl15w;full][/previewyoutube]

Armed with adaptive weapons - the Energy Cannon and the Remedium Sprayer - and aided by a valuable grapnel for fast and agile travel, Nano+ battles pathogens, mutated organisms, and deranged nanobots while healing allies and interacting with a unique environment.

As part of Steam FPS Fest 2024, "Project Remedium" is available with an incredible [b]90% discount[/b]! Don't miss out on this opportunity!

notes.title: Prison Remedium BUNDLE is here!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Community![/h1]

Together with the Baked Games Team, we have prepared a unique bundle that will guarantee hours of entertainment. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25854424/69c45f06b257246fc47347033ac059e1247eeb65.png[/img]

Try yourself in two different roles! As a tough prison guard or a nanobot.

[b]The bundle will give you access to:[/b]
[b]- Project Remedium
- Prison Simulator[/b]

[h2]About:[/h2]

[b]Project Remedium[/b] is a story-driven action shooter set inside a human body devastated by illness and bad circumstances. It's a post-apocalypse of sorts, a really tiny one, but for a nanobot named Nano+, the body is a whole world. 

[b]Prison Simulator[/b] get a taste of prison life! Become a prison guard and deal with dangerous convicts. Prison management, lots of daily activities. As a prison guard, your job is to maintain order behind the prison walls.


[b]JOIN OUR DISCORD[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25854424/fabd4c56edd673cc3261064c9d6f80bee0b8ff51.png[/img] [/url]


Have a good one!
Atomic Jelly Team

notes.title: Release date moved to August 28!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25854424/5a75acc005922e60840938d234d499d530d2d16b.png[/img]

Dear Friends! Testing at the final stages of game's development proven that the [b]Project Remedium[/b] player's interface requires improvements to increase clarity and intuitiveness. Implementing such changes and testing them requires an extra week... 

August 21 release date has to be moved and we are very sorry to keep you waiting so long. This final rescheduling will guarantee that on [b]August 28[/b] a much more impressive and effective Project Remedium reaches the stores. Thanks for your understanding!

notes.title: 8 language versions available!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25854424/965175f3dca1093d7c16e5b1e1bf5c5209522d2c.png[/img]

[b]Project Remedium[/b] is fully voiced-over in English, but players can choose the language of all the subtitles and texts. There are 8 language versions in total!

Aside from the [b]English version, the game will arrive with [b]Polish[/b], [b]German[/b], [b]French[/b], [b]Spanish[/b], [b]Italian[/b], [b]Russian[/b] and [b]Chinese[/b] translations.

notes.title: NanoVision
notes.content:
Welcome to another update! Take a look!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25854424/c46f88cf920c73c9a415a2f25315374281cd5ced.jpg[/img]

We introduce you to the newest [b]Substance[/b] that can be used by Nano+: the [b]NanoVision[/b]. It's basically a temporary optic system boost that allows the smallest of doctors to seek out both dangers and useful elements of the microscopic world with ease. It can be used for locating goodies, picking the sneaky morbs from the natural camouflage the Organism's backdrop offers them. So you see it's very handy.

See everything from a whole new perspective! What do you prefer - to take a 
[b]GOOD[/b] look or to take the [b]BEST[/b] look?
